card.name: Last word before a clause-ending break
card.fires_on: A noun or adjective that ends a phrase just before a comma, period or parenthesis, such as 'behavior', 'suspected', 'caregivers' or 'origin'. It appears in warning sentences in drug-label text.

card.plain: It fires on the last word of a phrase, right before the sentence moves on to a comma or new clause.
